No More Comprehensive Health Information. I have had this app since 2018, and it had been wonderful to track my cycle as I approach peri-menopause. The latest update takes this from a useful tool with information on sexual health and wellness, contraception, and family planning to a pretty single-use app that blares: “YOU SHOULD BE GETTING PREGNANT NOW!”

Nope. I am out of my child bearing years, and regret ever giving them a dime. This app is downright scary at this point for anyone in the USA with a uterus. Time for us all to go back to paper journals that can’t be subpoenaed.

Too much nonsense. It used to be super simple to use this app for what I wanted it for, to track my period, but this app started getting more and more complicated with every update. I am not someone who is interested in all the bells and whistles it has to offer. I have never been interested in anything but the calendar. I don’t need to know what others are going through, what creepy sex things people do, and whatever else it has. 

If you’re looking for a simple app to just see if you’re going to be annoyed on your next trip or some other special date, get a different one. This one is too much. If you want an app that will tell you a million different useless things, then get this one. 

Devs, don’t bother replying to me. I have been annoyed for almost a decade using this app. I would switch over to another one, but this one already has all my periods since 2017. It would be too much trouble to switch over or I would have many years ago.

It also gave you daily horoscopes that were fun to read and would say which hormones were higher or lower during your cycle and how they affected your mood. Completely Disenchanted. To the greedy and predatory marketing team, 

I received a notification that as a reward for over 10 years of use, I had access to an exclusive offer of $2.99/month subscription to premium. (Or I guess you all have vacillated back to selling out to Glow.) To my surprise, I was charged ~$35 + a processing fee. Upon further research, I learned that I wasn’t the only one who has fallen victim to your misleading ads.

This approach to advertising and notifications is intolerable. There’s no reason to be dishonest or steal. What was the point of congratulating me on consecutive years of use, if this is how you are going to treat your “valued customers”?! This has caused me great distress, as I anticipated a ~$3 charge and not ~$35. After contacting Apple who will take a max 48 hrs to process a verdict and then another 48 hrs to potentially wire a refund. Which cannot be expedited since it is an automated system. I will be incurring an overdraft fee from my bank. That I cannot afford, because these are horrid times, on top of the initial charge. This process has completely disenchanted me from the previously met expectations of this app. And quite frankly, ever since the name change and collaboration, I have noticed a shift in practices that I believe have no place in a period tracker app. If you would stoop this low, I am deeply suspicious of how my sensitive data and medical information is being handled. This needs to change.

reviews.text:
Long-Time User - DON’T DOWNLOAD. I’ve had this app since I was a sophomore in high school, almost 10 years ago. Honestly, I’ve used this app to track almost 90% of the periods I’ve ever had in my life. I’ve seen this app change from a wonderful, easy-to-use app to an awful, ad-ridden, unusable waste of space.

Ever since Eve became Glow, every single time I open the app, I’m immediately bombarded with a full-screen in-app advertisement promoting whatever sale they have for their subscription.

Bro. I’m just trying to track my period. I don’t want to spend $40 or $70 on an app and I hate that I have to communicate that EVERY single time I open this one. It makes me HATE checking for my period. If I didn’t have almost a decade’s worth of menstrual data on this app, I would have deleted this app and switched to another one MONTHS, if not years, ago.

I genuinely hate what this app has become, and trust me, it was WONDERFUL in the beginning. Now even adding my period is a chore. I swear, as soon as I get the energy to manually input my period data into another period tracking app, I will GLEEFULLY delete this one.

TLDR: SAVE YOURSELF THE TROUBLE, DON’T DOWNLOAD THIS APP
